description: Two storey side and rear extensions; single storey rear extension, conversion of garage into habitable room with alterations to roof; alterations and extension to roof; rear dormer; rooflights in side roof slope and crown; solar panels on main hipped roof; external alterations; rear garden landscaping (demolition of outbuilding)
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpFirst" style="margin-bottom:0cm;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify;line-height:normal;mso-layout-grid-align:none;text-autospace:
none"><span style="color: rgb(33, 33, 33);">The proposals would interrupt
the important openness to the side of the dwelling by virtue of the combination
of the scale and siting of the proposed two-storey side extension, the pitched
roof single-storey side and rear addition between the house and the garage, the
pitched roof design of the garage and the added trellis to the gates infilling
the characteristic gap between built form (notwithstanding the discrepancies in
the submitted plans on the positioning and impact on visual openness as
identified by officers). The proposed two-storey side addition presented in the
plans would also fail to represent a sufficiently subservient addition, via the
absence of any set down from the main roof ridge. The proposals in combination fail
to result in a sufficiently subordinate development and would not </span>preserve
or enhance the character or appearance of South Hill Avenue Conservation Area.
The proposals are found to be contrary to Policies HE6(4) and HE9(1) of the
National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policies DR3.D and HC1 of the London
Plan (2021) and Policies GR1 and HE1(A) and (D) of the Harrow Local Plan
(2021-2041), as well as at odds with the objectives of the South Hill Avenue
Conservation Area Appraisal and Management Strategy.</p>
